business.name: Rocksteady LLC
business.tagline: High quality work at an affordable price. You will not be disappointed. Happy to quote any job, big or small.

hero.headline: Built steady.
hero.sub: High-quality work at an affordable price — you will not be disappointed. Happy to quote any job, big or small.

services.headline: Full-service remodeling, inside and out.
services.sub: From a single room to a full exterior overhaul — one crew, one point of contact, no subcontractor guesswork.

items.title: Bathroom Remodels
items.body: Full gut-and-rebuild or targeted updates — tile, fixtures, vanities, and layout changes done right the first time.

items.title: Whole-Home Renovation
items.body: Kitchens, flooring, drywall, and finish carpentry. We handle the parts of the job homeowners dread coordinating.

items.title: Porches & Decks
items.body: Outdoor living spaces built to last through Colorado weather — from framing to final finish.

items.title: Exterior & Structural
items.body: Siding, structural repair, and outdoor work that holds up. If it's attached to your house, we can likely handle it.

process.headline: Three steps to a finished job.
process.sub: No pressure, no hidden costs — just a clear path from first call to walkthrough.

steps.title: Reach out
steps.body: Tell us about the project — size, timeline, and what you're picturing. Photos help but aren't required.

steps.title: Free estimate
steps.body: We walk the site, talk through options, and give you a straightforward quote — no surprise line items later.

steps.title: We build it
steps.body: Clear communication from start to finish, with the same crew and the same point of contact throughout.

aboutTeaser.headline: A name that's also a promise.
aboutTeaser.quote: High quality work at an affordable price. You will not be disappointed.
aboutTeaser.body: That's not a slogan we picked off a template — it's how every estimate and every job gets handled here. Small crew, direct communication, and work that's built to stay level long after we've moved to the next job.

mission.headline: Work that stays level, long after we leave.
mission.intro: Rocksteady LLC was built on a simple idea: homeowners deserve a contractor who shows up, communicates clearly, and charges a fair price for real craftsmanship. No inflated estimates, no disappearing after the deposit clears.

values.title: Fair pricing, every time
values.body: We quote every job — big or small — the same way: honestly, and with no hidden line items added after the fact.

values.title: Direct communication
values.body: You talk to the people actually doing the work, not a rotating cast of subcontractors and middlemen.

values.title: Built to last
values.body: We treat every project like it has our name on it — because it does. Quality that holds up long after the job is done.

mission.closing: Whether it's a single bathroom or a full exterior remodel, our goal is the same: work you're not disappointed in, at a price that makes sense.

contact.headline: Let's talk about your project.
contact.sub: Send a few details about the job and we'll follow up to schedule a walkthrough — no obligation.
contact.formNote: Opens your email client — this form doesn't submit directly from the page yet.
contact.facebookNote: Want to see completed work first? Check out our project photos on Facebook.
